messages.subject: "system.file" in run_examples
parts:
I get the following result running the lovely devtools::run_examples() utlity:

> f = system.file("example-data/continents", package = "rgdal2")
> x = openOGRLayer(f)
Error in openOGR(fname, readonly) : Unable to open file

I think system.file breaks the program because of the special environment where the package is installed. Running the example as "example(<topic>)" works fine.

THK
